resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Make briefs list existing assertions on text the brief changes
body:
Outcome: `krn brief check` or the krn-lead brief step requires a "Consumers" line listing existing test assertions on any instruction, message or schema text the brief changes (from `git grep -n` over test/), so a worker is never told both to change the text and to keep those tests unchanged.
Evidence: t-t8v24zs brief (`.krn/runs/lead/worker-turn-finish/brief.md`) told the worker to drop "Never commit; the lead commits" and to keep every worker test unchanged; test/worker/hardening.test.ts:251 asserted that text and round 2 reported blocked on it.
Proof: a brief changing an asserted literal without naming the asserting test fails the check, or the krn-lead step 4 text names the grep.
